root_cause.defect: unified propose_next_action exposed an opaque, unrequired `arguments` object
root_cause.observed_effect: 8/8 recorded live model proposals omitted `arguments` entirely; 6 rejected for `arguments.query is required`, 2 memory_read proposals hydrated by code
root_cause.parsing_not_at_fault: the traced proposal is the verbatim json.loads of the provider tool_call arguments; _parse_json performs no key filtering
root_cause.why_the_followup_fix_was_insufficient: making `arguments` required with a flat union of every permitted tool's fields still left per-tool requiredness in a Chinese prose description - the same signal class that had already failed 8/8

fix.design: one named function per permitted tool; each function's parameters are that tool's own model schema from the executor catalog
fix.parser: named call -> existing internal proposal {decision, tool, arguments} + investigation metadata lifted out of arguments; validator/executor/permission/evidence/budget contracts unchanged

wire_change.degrade: one-time degrade to auto on a tool_choice 400

fix.no_auto_fabrication: a named call missing a required argument is still rejected; rag_search.query is never invented by code

wire_audit.enum_leak_removed: memory_read.query keeps its view enum; rag_search.query has no enum

protocol_smoke.purpose: prove the provider accepts the v3 request shape before spending the one-shot cohort
protocol_smoke.raw_arguments: {"query":"阿司匹林 布洛芬 相互作用 药物相互作用","gap_id":"interaction_check","expected_observation":"找到关于阿司匹林和布洛芬相互作用的证据"}
protocol_smoke.note: minimal two-function probe (rag_search + respond), not the full agent contract; the cohort exercises the full one

live.failure_attribution: all remaining failures are provider 429/1305; no protocol failure remained

known_gaps: provider availability (36.4% actual responses) is the binding constraint, not the protocol
default PLANNER_PROVIDER_RETRIES=0 removes the one bounded 429 retry the previous protocol used
real local retrieval end-to-end not re-tested
default-OFF review_worker still uses the legacy unified propose_next_action schema
